title: Zuno Agent Tool Usage Note (OKF v0.2 Markdown bundle frontmatter)
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter block of agents/<name>/tools/<capability>.md (ADR-0513, promoting agents/<name>/tools/ from the ADR-0502 stub to real Stage-2 content). `rag`/`tool`/`policy` are Zuno-invented document kinds with no OKF-core meaning - every field below is [ZUNO EXT]. One file documents how this agent actually uses one MCP tool/capability it has already declared, i.e. present in some agents/<name>/tasks/*.md's `zuno.allowed_tools`. This document is descriptive only: it never grants tool-call authorization, which stays entirely `allowed_tools` (per task) intersect policies/tools/tool-policy.yaml intersect platform/bindings/tools/tool-bindings.yaml (ADR-0011, ADR-0116) - the same posture ADR-0503's generated Authorization matrix takes, and it must never become an enforcement input. Consumed today only by platform/supply-chain/validate_okf_bundle.py's cross-reference check; no runtime service reads this file.

okf_version.description: [OKF CORE] OKF envelope version this document conforms to.

type.description: [OKF CORE shape, ZUNO-defined kind] Document kind. Always "tool" for files under agents/<name>/tools/.

title.description: [OKF CORE] Human-readable title, e.g. "Confluence page search".

zuno.description: [ZUNO EXT] The tool/capability this note documents, and how this agent's tasks actually use it.

capability.description: MCP tool name this note documents, drawn from the same platform tool-policy vocabulary as zuno-okf-task-v0.2.schema.json's `allowed_tools` (legacy pre-ADR-0116 name or ADR-0116 canonical `<domain>.<resource>.<verb>` capability ID - this list is intentionally duplicated from the task schema rather than shared, following this repository's established convention of duplicating small, well-specified vocabulary across independent OKF documents, see platform/supply-chain/validate_okf_bundle.py's docstring). Must be one this agent can actually reach: present in at least one entry of `used_by_tasks` below's own `zuno.allowed_tools`.

used_by_tasks.description: Which of this agent's tasks (agents/<name>/tasks/<task>.md) declare `capability` above in their `zuno.allowed_tools`. Documents an existing fact; adding a task name here grants nothing - the task's own frontmatter is the actual ceiling.

live_read.description: Informational mirror of some task's `zuno.live_read_tool` pointing at this capability (ADR-0342/WP-33). Documentary only - the task frontmatter is the field Agent Runtime actually reads.

usage_notes.description: Free-text: how this agent's tasks actually invoke this tool - typical inputs, expected outputs, when it is chosen over alternatives.

known_limitations.description: Free-text list of known constraints or gotchas when this agent calls this tool (rate limits, partial coverage, demo-only behavior, etc.).
